recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future changes to search method conformance or cross-page ownership should be made under newer HTTP/search trackers rather than restoring the original FHIR-38994 link direction, which would duplicate or weaken the current FHIR-39137 source structure.
issue_request: FHIR-38994 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-I R5 clarification asking the HTTP page to match the Search page's GET/POST search-method guidance by replacing an old POST form-encoding note with a cross-link and adding a 405 Method Not Allowed status-code entry for unsupported GET or POST search methods.
initial_application: Historical commit f47290bddbd45abf5ead98478c1796e50bb8ea83 applied the seed by changing source/http.html to point to search.html#getvspost, adding the requested 405 search error entry, and adding 404/405 to the search rows in the HTTP interaction summary table; that commit is already an ancestor of the current combined branch.
additional_context: Later same-family Published issue FHIR-39137 moved the detailed HTTP search transport guidance from source/search.html to source/http.html and left the Search page pointing back to the HTTP page. The current build includes both pages via publish.ini and source/hierarchy.xml, so the current source arrangement supersedes the literal original link direction while preserving the requested implementer guidance.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because source/http.html already states GET/POST search support, includes method-choice considerations, and lists 405 Method Not Allowed for unsupported GET or POST, while source/search.html points to http.html#search for HTTP method details.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive with Modification cleanup moved HTTP search transport-method content from search.html to http.html and left search.html pointing back to the HTTP page; it is already represented by a combined-branch reconciliation commit.
